arxiv-1906-00270.title: Natural Image Noise Dataset
arxiv-1906-00270.creator: Benoit Brummer, Christophe De Vleeschouwer
arxiv-1906-00270.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks have been the focus of research aiming to solve image denoising problems, but their performance remains unsatisfactory for most applications. These networks are trained with synthetic noise distributions that do not accurately reflect the noise captured by image sensors.

arxiv-2207-05087.title: CRESCENDO : An on-the-fly Fokker-Planck Solver for Spectral Cosmic Rays in Cosmological Simulations 2022 CRESCENDO : An on-the-fly Fokker-Planck Solver for Spectral Cosmic Rays in Cosmological Simulations – E
arxiv-2207-05087.creator: Ludwig M. Böss, Ulrich P. Steinwandel, Klaus Dolag, Harald Lesch
arxiv-2207-05087.description: Abstract Non-thermal emission from relativistic Cosmic Ray (CR) electrons gives insight into the strength and morphology of intra-cluster magnetic fields, as well as providing powerful tracers of structure formation shocks. Emission caused by CR protons on the other hand still challenges current observations and is therefore testing models of proton acceleration at intra-cluster shocks.

arxiv-2209-00604.title: A short proof of a conjecture of Matsushita
arxiv-2209-00604.creator: Benjamin Bakker
arxiv-2209-00604.description: Abstract . In this note we build on the arguments of van Geemen and Voisin [ 18 ] to prove a conjecture of Matsushita that a Lagrangian fibration of an irreducible hyperkähler manifold is either isotrivial or of maximal variation.

arxiv-2402-09585.title: Domain Adaptation for Contrastive Audio-Language Models
arxiv-2402-09585.creator: Soham Deshmukh, Rita Singh, Bhiksha Raj
arxiv-2402-09585.description: Abstract Audio-Language Models (ALM) aim to be general-purpose audio models by providing zero-shot capabilities at test time. The zero-shot performance of ALM improves by using suitable text prompts for each domain. The text prompts are usually hand-crafted through an ad-hoc process and lead to a drop in ALM generalization and out-of-distribution performance.

arxiv-2403-11457.title: First-Principles Calculation of Hubbard U for Terbium Metal under High Pressure
arxiv-2403-11457.creator: Logan A. Burnett, Matthew P. Clay, Yogesh K. Vohra, Cheng-Chien Chen
arxiv-2403-11457.description: Abstract Using density functional theory (DFT) and linear response approaches, we compute the on-site Hubbard interaction U U of elemental Terbium (Tb) metal in the pressure range ∼ 0 − 65 \sim 0-65 GPa. The resulting first-principles U U values with experimental crystal structures enable us to examine the magnetic properties of Tb using a self-consistent DFT+U method.

arxiv-2407-06826.title: VRDSynth: Synthesizing Programs for Multilingual Visually Rich Document Information Extraction Conference: ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis; 16-20 September, 2024; Vienna, Austria
arxiv-2407-06826.creator: Dat Nguyen, Tung Do-Viet, Hung Nguyen-Duy, Tuan-Hai Luu, Hung Le, Bach Le, Patanamon (Pick) Thongtanunam
arxiv-2407-06826.description: Abstract . Businesses often need to query visually rich documents (VRDs), e.g., purchase receipts, medical records, and insurance forms, among many other forms from multiple vendors, to make informed decisions. As such, several techniques have been proposed to automatically extract independent entities of interest from VRDs such as extracting price tags from purchase receipts, etc.

arxiv-2504-16511.title: QuaDMix: Quality-Diversity Balanced Data Selection for Efficient LLM Pretraining
arxiv-2504-16511.creator: Fengze Liu, Weidong Zhou, Binbin Liu, Zhimiao Yu, Yifan Zhang, Haobin Lin, Yifeng Yu, Bingni Zhang, Xiaohuan Zhou, Taifeng Wang, Yong Cao
arxiv-2504-16511.description: Abstract Quality and diversity are two critical metrics for the training data of large language models (LLMs), positively impacting performance. Existing studies often optimize these metrics separately, typically by first applying quality filtering and then adjusting data proportions. However, these approaches overlook the inherent trade-off between quality and diversity, necessitating their joint consideration.

arxiv-2507-14622.title: Propagation Channel Modeling for LEO Satellite Missions Using Ray-Tracing Simulations
arxiv-2507-14622.creator: Wahab Khawaja 1 , Ismail Guvenc 2 , and Rune Hylsberg Jacobsen 1
arxiv-2507-14622.description: Abstract This work presents a high-resolution, ray-tracing-based channel modeling for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite-to-ground links in a suburban environment at X-band. Using simulations conducted in Wireless InSite, we develop a parametric channel model that characterizes both large- and small-scale fading effects across different satellite elevation angles.

arxiv-2511-02295.title: Electronic state of superconductivity in line nodal material CaSb 2 \mathrm{CaSb}_{2} under pressure up to 4.2 ​ GPa 4.2\,\mathrm{GPa}
arxiv-2511-02295.creator: Shumpei Oguchi 1, Kenji Ishida 1, Atsutoshi Ikeda 2, Yoshiteru Maeno 3, and Shunsaku Kitagawa 1
arxiv-2511-02295.description: Abstract We report the results of resistance measurements under pressure up to 4.2 ​ GPa 4.2\,\mathrm{GPa} on single-crystalline CaSb 2 \mathrm{CaSb}_{2} , which shows the maximum of superconducting transition temperature T c T_{\mathrm{c}} at 3.1 ​ GPa 3.1\,\mathrm{GPa} . At room temperature, R ⁡ ( P ) R(P) shows a subtle anomaly at 3.1 ​ GPa 3.1\,\mathrm{GPa} .

pmc-10621950.title: Epidemiologic features of neonatal sepsis and its COVID-19 associated temporal patterns in Jimma Medical Center, Ethiopia: A Joinpoint regression analysis
pmc-10621950.creator: Daniel Geleta, Gemeda Abebe, Netsanet Workneh, Getenet Beyene
pmc-10621950.description: BackgroundNeonatal sepsis remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in neonates across all regions, including Africa. Compared to developed and some developing countries, there are relatively few epidemiological trends for neonatal sepsis and associated patterns with COVID-19 in Ethiopia. We modeled an epidemiological trend and pattern to aid in the monitoring of changes in neonatal sepsis.

pmc-10663682.title: Polymorphism in ADAM33 gene associated with asthmatics in West Bengal, India - An investigation by in-silico analysis
pmc-10663682.creator: Saheen Sultana, Priyajit Banerjee, Indranil Ganai, Arghya Laha, Nasima Sultana, Himani Biswas, Nimai Chandra Saha, Saibal Moitra, Sanjoy Podder
pmc-10663682.description: IntroductionAsthma is one of the common chronic polygenic inflammatory diseases. Genome wide association studies have identified ADAM33 as an asthma candidate gene. The present study investigated possible association of rs2280090 (T1), rs2280091 (T2) and rs3918396 (S1) single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) of ADAM33 with aeroallergen induced asthma in West Bengal population, India.

pmc-10710944.title: Biological activities of nitromethylene analogues of imidacloprid with a 4,5-dimethylated imidazolidine ring
pmc-10710944.creator: Madoka Yamamura, Satoshi Yamauchi, Hisashi Nishiwaki
pmc-10710944.description: Four nitromethylene analogues of imidacloprid (CH-IMIs) having a 4,5-dimethylated (diMe) imidazolidine ring were stereospecifically synthesized to evaluate their affinity for the nicotinic acetylcholine receptors of the housefly Musca domestica. Among the analogues, the 4S,5R-diMe analogue showed the highest receptor affinity (Ki=0.39 nM). The insecticidal activity against M. domestica of the synthesized compounds was also measured under synergistic and nonsynergistic conditions.

pmc-11385077.title: Meta-analysis of oral microbiome reveals sex-based diversity in biofilms during periodontitis
pmc-11385077.creator: Rita Del Pinto, Claudio Ferri, Mario Giannoni, Fabio Cominelli, Theresa T Pizarro, Davide Pietropaoli
pmc-11385077.description: Sex is an often overlooked, yet compulsory, biological variable when performing biomedical research. Periodontitis is a common yet progressively debilitating chronic inflammatory disorder affecting the tissues supporting teeth that ultimately leads to tooth loss if left untreated. The incidence of periodontitis is sex biased, with increased prevalence in males compared with females but with unknown etiology.

pmc-13237208.title: Differences between human and AI scoring: A meta-analysis of english language assessments
pmc-13237208.creator: Bingwei Li, Xiao Qunhan, Chunhua Mao
pmc-13237208.description: Despite a burgeoning body of research on using AI scoring systems in English assessments, concerns regarding their reliability persist. To fill this gap, this meta-analysis examined the AI-human scoring differences and the variables moderating these differences by synthesizing the results of 21 empirical studies with a total of 401,698 participants.

pmc-13458762.title: A Visual Question Answering Dataset for Benchmarking Vision-Language Models in Plant Science
pmc-13458762.creator: Syed Nazmus Sakib, Nafiul Haque, Mohammad Zabed Hossain, Shifat E Arman
pmc-13458762.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Existing plant-disease datasets target classification and detection, leaving vision-language models unable to support interactive, reasoning-based diagnosis. To address this, we present PlantExpertVQA, a large-scale visual question answering (VQA) dataset designed to advance vision-language models for agricultural decision-making. It is compiled from 45 open-source datasets, including the widely used PlantVillage corpus, and comprises 765,186 high-quality question-answer (QA) pairs grounded over 150,841 images spanning 38 crop species and 89 disease conditions. Questions are organized into 3 levels of cognitive complexity and 9 distinct categories.

pmc-13683496.creator: Hasan Pala, Murat Tuncel, Suayib Yalcin, Erdem Karabulut, Nezih Akkapulu, Timucin Erol, Omer Ugur
pmc-13683496.description: ObjectivesTo compare the diagnostic performance of 18 F-Fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) and 68Ga-fibroblast activation protein inhibitor (FAPI) positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) in gastrointestinal malignancies, with particular emphasis on lesion detection, peritoneal disease assessment, and the potential added value of dual-time-point FAPI imaging.
